title: Heatwave to worsen firefighting conditions in France's southwest
summary: A heatwave is expected to hit southwestern France on June 15, worsening firefighting conditions. The region has experienced drought and high temperatures for several days. Firefighters are preparing for the worst as they face low humidity and strong winds. The French government has issued a warning for the risk of wildfires. The US western states are also experiencing a heatwave, with Oregon and Washington at high risk due to low humidity and powerful winds.
